<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>UP Rajya Sabha results:</strong> All 10 Rajya Sabha candidates from Uttar Pradesh were elected unopposed, with the BJP securing 8 of the available seats.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Election Commission criticism:</strong> Shiv Sena (UBT) leader Aaditya Thackeray has expressed a lack of faith in the Election Commission, echoing broader INDIA bloc allegations of electoral malpractice raised during a recent meeting with President Murmu.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Political sparring:</strong> The BJP has dismissed the INDIA bloc&#x27;s account of their meeting with the President as politically motivated, with party spokespersons countering the opposition&#x27;s claims.</li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Institutional scrutiny:</strong> Amid current tensions, historical context shows that the BJP has previously protested against the Election Commission, highlighting the ongoing debate regarding the institution&#x27;s role in Indian democracy.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Aviation policy:</strong> The Union government has officially approved a new policy framework for sustainable aviation fuel to promote greener energy standards in the sector.</li>
</ul>
